findings.detail: CLI now unconditionally calls a fresh-only localFinancialExitCode for every validated local plan. The validator rejects adverse results and requires a local driver plus four current reserved submissions. Previously any successfully returned PASS mapped to 0 and other returned statuses mapped to 2. Stale integration can successfully return INCOMPLETE with adverse evidence and no driver; writer accepts it, but the new selector throws and CLI catch maps it to 1. A controlled contained continuation PASS has four receipts including historical stages but only two current reservations; writer accepts it and old selector yields 0, whereas new selector throws and yields 1. Recovery has three current reservations.
findings.reachability: Stale INCOMPLETE is a currently reachable successful-return production shape because production cleanup containmentComplete is false and stale outcome can return rather than throw. Contained PASS for recovery/continuation/adverse is an existing source contract; current production cleanup always false means these PASS cases are controlled-contract regressions, not observed operational results. Continuation has four recorded stages, not two; two denotes new submissions.
findings.requiredRepair: Route the fresh completion validator only for fresh execution using the already validated mutually exclusive plan modes. Preserve prior status PASS -> 0, otherwise -> 2 for existingDeployment, existingInitializedLoan, existingInitializedSwap and existingStaleLoan successful returns, while retaining current thrown-failure behavior and deadline checks. Add meaningful selector regressions for excluded modes; no new dispatch or framework is needed.
